{{Quote|Wampa1, you slicer-dreaming dirt magnet&ndash;you couldn't slice bread with a lightsaber.|myrlinator, to wampa1, in a post on the Cularin holonet node|<ref name="destabilization">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/swlf20040105|text=Destabilization}}</ref>}}
The handle '''myrlinator''' served as the user ID of an individual active on the [[Cularin holonet node]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of [[Operation False Horizon]], the slicer [[Tiny.f]] shared on a Cularin holonet node forum a decrypted communique purportedly extracted from a [[Thaereian]] [[HoloNet/Legends|holonet]] node that referenced a plot by the [[Thaereian military]] to destabilize the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]]. To verify the authenticity of the message, myrlinator traced the [[databit history]] of the holonet node on which Tiny.f had circulated the note back to the origin point of the data at Thaereian node th.x1.1.3.8. Myrlinator shared on the holonet forum details of the origins of the data and also engaged in a heated argument with fellow slicer [[wampa1]], accusing wampa1 of being incapable of using a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] to slice [[Bread/Legends|bread]].<ref name="destabilization" />
